exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Verb + Kata for Method".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! Verb 方 (〜hou) matches "Verb + Kata for Method".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is Verb 方 (〜hou).
exercises.explanation: Expresses how to do something; forms nouns meaning "way of doing."
